messages:
alex: thanks y'all for attending runtime roadmap. jotting follow-ups here. main ask: what's the timeline for kernel v5 perf improvements?
maya: thanks alex. leadership said Q2 for initial perf gains but canary to start earlier
ryan: can you clarify "initial perf gains" — is that latency P50/P95 or throughput? :thinking_face:
tana: leadership (ben) said P95 latency targets first, then throughput/throughput per $ optimization
ben: correct — v5 focuses on attention kernel rewrite to hit P95 across 32k sequences. throughput wins come in v5.1
priya: for canary, do we plan cross-region rollout or single-region first? concerns about fallbacks
ben: single-region to start (us-east-1), automated fallback to v4 variants if regressions detected
ryan: what's the rollout criteria? automated gates or manual sign-off?
maya: automated gates driven by perf-monkey checks + canary tracing. manual hold for any infra-level errors
tana: question on batching defaults — any suggestion for default batch timeout for hosted vs dedicated?
alex: ops recommended adaptive batching: 8ms target for hosted, 12-15ms for dedicated depending on pool size
priya: cache eviction policy — will we keep LRU or switch to segmented TTL? we saw regrowth issues last week
ben: plan is segmented TTL for hot prefixes, LRU fallback for cold items. will publish config schema
ryan: small ask — can we get a sample config snippet we can drop into dedicated clusters?
ben: yes, will add to docs. example:
```
kv_cache:
  policy: segmented_ttl
  segments:
    - name: hot
      ttl_ms: 600000
    - name: cold
      ttl_ms: 3600000
batching:
  strategy: adaptive
  target_ms: 12
```
maya: about kernel testing — will we run microbench harnesses on actual customer-like prompts or only synthetic tokens?
tana: both. microbench on synthetic, e2e on curated prompt suites from sample customers (anonymized)
alex: action items: ben to share canary runbook + config by EOW, priya to draft dedicated config snippet, maya to add perf checkpoints to roadmap
ben: noted. I'll post runbook here when ready :calendar:
deploy-bot: Canary deployment for kernel-v5 scheduled: 2025-04-02 03:00 UTC — status: queued
ryan: thanks, folks. any docs or slides from the all-hands we can reference?
alex: slides uploaded to #docs and link in the all-hands thread. i'll drop the link here shortly
maya: one last thing — monitoring alert thresholds; can we get clearer P50/P95 targets per model size?
ben: adding to action items. we'll attach a table to the runbook
tana: thanks everyone — closing thread for follow-ups. ping me if anything else.
